# Blowhorn Tells

> Am I a Bot? A free bot-detection and browser fingerprint test at
> https://tells.blowhorn.ai/ . It inspects the visiting browser, scores what
> websites can see about it, and returns a verdict with the evidence.

## For agents

- Instructions for agents and scripts: https://tells.blowhorn.ai/agents/
  (how to drive the page with Playwright or Puppeteer, the API routes
  /api/ping, /api/check and POST /api/report, how the verdict is scored,
  and how to interpret a run.)
- /api/check and POST /api/report success bodies include schema_version 1.
  The report schema is schemas/report.schema.json and the check schema is
  schemas/check.schema.json (draft 2020-12). Download JSON is that body.
- What each check means: https://tells.blowhorn.ai/checks/
  (one page per check: what it reads, how its result is decided, why it
  matters, and where it matters most.)
- Open check catalog, catalog_version 1.0.0:
  https://github.com/blowhorn-ai/tells/blob/master/schemas/check-catalog.json
  (schema schemas/check-catalog.schema.json). Every check row and every
  scored reason, including not-available rows and the 0-point
  fingerprint_randomized reason. Changelog:
  https://tells.blowhorn.ai/checks/changelog/
- Which platforms care about which tells:
  https://tells.blowhorn.ai/checks/platforms/
- The interaction test (Start, type a fixed phrase, Submit): its 15 int_*
  checks and thresholds are at https://tells.blowhorn.ai/checks/interaction/.
  They are provisional and warn-only until calibrated on 20+ human runs.
  Harnesses read the full /api/report response from [data-tells-report="raw"]
  (pre#jsonOut). The interaction report is /client/interaction, with
  server-derived check statuses. It is complete when
  /client/interaction/task/completed is true. Before Submit, that element
  holds "No report yet." or a report whose interaction is not completed.
- Compare two saved reports in the browser (nothing is uploaded):
  https://tells.blowhorn.ai/compare/
  Paste or drop two Download JSON files. The page diffs verdict label, score and
  reasons, check-row status and summary, and the flag groups on the result page.
  schema_version must match for scores to be comparable; overlapping fields are
  still diffed. Files that are not Tells reports are rejected. IP addresses,
  WebRTC candidates, history length, extension probes, fingerprint hashes, GPU
  strings and font lists are omitted from the diff.
- The tool: https://tells.blowhorn.ai/
- Source: https://github.com/blowhorn-ai/tells

## Rules in one line

30 API requests per minute per route and source IP; never send real
personal data; a bot verdict for an automated browser is the tool working.
